name: devdesigner
description: Interactive database schema diagramming app (Angular + NestJS + shared TS package).

scripts.dev: npm run ng cache clean -w client && npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,green "npm run watch:shared" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w mcp && npm run test -w desktop && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint:client: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint:styles -w client
scripts.verify: npm run build:shared && npm run lint && npm run lint:client && npm run check:cycles && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w mcp
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w mcp && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist -w desktop
